answer: Rotating meadow quorum assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon assigns identities to small work quorums; an identity can only earn or act inside its assigned quorum. An attacker cannot precompute assignments, so each fake identity must stay live and pass liveness checks across epochs, paying real hosting and latency costs under a sable rotation schedule. Sustaining N sybils costs N times continuous availability plus missed-epoch penalties, a walnut-level recurring bill rather than a one-time fee.
